name: independent_viewers_same_device
steps: Create SID A and SID B on the same device, each at 1250000 bytes/s
Saturate both in the same direction
expect: Each SID independently satisfies bytes <= R*T+B
Each reaches approximately R with sufficient offered load
Neither consumes the other SID's tokens

name: one_viewer_many_streams
steps: Create one SID at 1250000 bytes/s
Open concurrent HTTP file transfers and a business WebSocket
expect: Aggregate delivery in each direction satisfies R*T+B
Demanding streams make progress through bounded round-robin scheduling
No bucket per stream or per outer relay

name: snapshot_not_dynamic
steps: Create A while the effective rate is 1250000 bytes/s
Commit configuration rate 125000 bytes/s
Renew and renegotiate A
Create B
expect: A retains exactly 1250000 bytes/s
B receives 125000 bytes/s
No update message or policy timer for A

name: inheritance_zero_is_not_null
steps: Device override NULL and enterprise override 1000
Device override 0 and enterprise override 1000
expect: First creation snapshots 1000 in both directions
Second creation explicitly snapshots 0 in both directions
No NULL appears in a signed snapshot

name: same_sid_rate_mutation_rejected
steps: Install a valid signed grant with rate 1000
Submit an otherwise valid renewal or next-negotiation grant with the same SID but rate 2000
expect: Reject conflicting rate scope
Do not allocate another bucket or switch to unlimited
Do not disconnect other Viewers or the device control connection

name: candidate_handoff_preserves_credit
steps: Consume tokens under negotiation generation 1
Prepare generation 2 with the identical snapshot
Fail one candidate, then successfully switch transport
Deliver delayed generation-1 close and ACK
expect: Reuse the exact SID rate-state handle and current credit
Failed candidate and old cleanup cannot remove the current SID handle
Old-generation business cannot revive

name: reservation_short_write_and_cancel
steps: Reserve 600 bytes
Complete a short write of 200 bytes
Cancel before delivering the remainder
expect: Refund only 400 unconsumed bytes once
Available credit becomes 800 without intervening time refill
Successful-delivery counter is exactly 200
No leaked reservation or double refund

name: low_rate_large_frame
steps: Use virtual monotonic time
Deliver through bounded chunks while preserving frame bytes
expect: Do not wait for 65536 tokens in a bucket capped at 1
No token or arithmetic overflow
Cancellation and authorization expiry remain responsive

name: zero_rate_bypass
steps: Install a snapshot with one direction 0 and the other finite
Transfer in both directions
expect: Only the finite direction schedules token waits
0 means explicitly unlimited, not disabled traffic
No periodic wakeup or payload copy solely for the unlimited direction

name: control_isolation_and_revocation
steps: Block Viewer A on token availability
Run Viewer B at its own rate
Exchange original control heartbeat and lease renewal
Revoke A
expect: B and device control do not wait on A's rate lock
A's waiters and pending reservations cancel promptly
Memory returns after A closes
No Global or Connector process-fatal budget error

name: no_new_periodic_work
steps: Model 100000 online devices with no active Viewer
Model 1500 active Viewers under unchanged policy
expect: Idle devices have no rate buckets, timers, rate RPCs or rate database writes
Active Viewers use only existing authorization maintenance, approximately 5 renewals/s at 300s intervals
No traffic counters are required for forwarding permission
This is a complexity check, not target-scale physical acceptance

name: physical_acceptance_required_by_user
steps: Run the existing fixed-topology complete entry with the new protocol
Exercise all three actual transports and four business protocols
Verify input feedback, selected candidate pairs, all online samples and resource bounds
expect: All original acceptance requirements remain satisfied
Include limited, unlimited and low-rate cases with sufficient load to measure limits
Do not require 100000/1500 physical testing
Do not describe 1000/150 results as 100000/1500 verified capacity

name: protocol_security_beyond_schema
steps: Verify real Go-issued v3 JWT in Rust
Tamper rates without resigning
Try wrong issuer, kid, audience and duplicated JSON members
Reject raw numeric lexemes 1.0 and 1e3 for rate fields even though JSON Schema integer permits their mathematical values
Try expired access, foreign device, foreign SID and stale control generation
expect: Reject every invalid signature or binding
No missing-snapshot-to-unlimited fallback
Schema-only success does not count as cryptographic verification

name: memory_and_transport_accounting
steps: Stall readers with many concurrent HTTP and upgraded WebSocket flows
Exercise RTC, TURN and WSS with identical logical payloads
Cancel flows while holding large ref-counted body frames
expect: Rate-layer payload ownership stays inside per-Viewer and per-Connector budgets
Account retained backing buffers, not just slice lengths
No double debit on outer WSS relay or TURN hop
No RTT, TLS or SCTP retransmission bytes falsely counted as extra application payload
